ev.q: Nearly 8% of persons aged ≥12 years (6% of males and 10% of females) report current depression.
Source: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data, 2007–2010.
The figure shows the prevalence of current depression among persons aged ≥12 years
Nearly 8% of persons aged ≥12 years (6% of males and 10% of females) report current depression.
Females have higher rates of depression than males in every age group.
Males aged 40–59 years have higher rates of depression (7%) than males aged ≥60 years (5%).
Source: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data, 2007–2010.
